name: Gasthof Kienbergklamm
beschreibung: The Gasthof Kienbergklamm is situated on the outskirts of Kufstein in Tyrol. The Kienbergklamm gorge and the surrounding mountains define the inn's direct, scenic environment. The house offers an atmosphere steeped in tradition alongside authentic regional dining. Guests are welcomed by simple yet immaculately maintained room appointments. Amenities include a restaurant serving classic Tyrolean cuisine and an inviting outdoor guest garden. Hiking trails start right outside the doorstep, encouraging rewarding excursions into nature. The town centre of Kufstein is reachable by car in just a few minutes.
